summary: Lock-guarded delegation wrapper. Calls sub_58C5AC to obtain a critical-section state; when it is non-zero, runs the actual operation sub_58C43C(a1, a2, a3, state) while the lock is held, releases it with AddressRangeCriticalSectionLeave, and returns the operation's result. When the initial acquire result is zero, no operation runs and that zero is returned. The ABI lead labels this path as a CRT stream getc with lock/unlock, but the raw body shows only the locked delegation, not a getc primitive.

operations.description: Call sub_58C5AC() to acquire/probe the critical-section state; the result is kept in v4.
Only when the acquired state is non-zero does the guarded operation run; otherwise the function returns the zero result immediately.
Call sub_58C43C(a1, a2, a3, lockState) to perform the actual stream/address-range operation while the lock is held; the result is kept in v5.
Return the guarded operation's result v5 on success, or the zero acquire result on failure; the function is invoked by sub_587DB0.
